title: Ben Rich deathbed claim that we can go to the stars via ESP

tellings.quote: Ben Rich [snorts] who was the head of Lockheed Skunkworks on his deathbed said we have the the ability to go to the stars whenever we want and we've built it. And a journalist asked him, "Well, how do we do that?" And he goes, "Well, have you heard of ESP?" And the journalist goes, "Yes." And then he goes, "Well, that's how."
And then you have Ben Rich, former head of Lockheed Skunk Works, saying things like, "We already have the means to travel among the stars, but these technologies are locked up in black projects,
tellings.difference: Says the technology is locked up in black projects rather than giving the ESP punchline, dates it 1995, and does not frame it as a deathbed remark.
tellings.link_reason: The same Ben Rich statement that we already have the means to travel to the stars.

as_told.title: Ben Rich on star travel locked in black projects

tellings.quote: Later, Ben Rich apparently said this on his deathbed to John Andrews of Testors Motor Corporation.
tellings.difference: Names John Andrews of Testors as the person Rich said it to, where the story has an unnamed journalist, and leaves out the ESP line.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Ben Rich's deathbed claim about the hidden ability to travel to the stars.

as_told.title: Ben Rich asks Jan Harzan what he knows about ESP

plain: Ben Rich ran Lockheed Skunk Works, the aircraft company's secret design division. The story is that late in life, some say on his deathbed, he said the US already has the means to travel to the stars. In Michels's best-known version, a journalist asks him how, and Rich replies, "have you heard of ESP?," meaning extrasensory perception, or powers of the mind. "Well, that's how," he says. In other tellings Michels names a man called John Andrews of Testors as the person Rich said it to, or dates the remark to 1995 and quotes Rich saying the technologies "are locked up in black projects," meaning secretly funded programs. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says it was a man named Jan Harzan who asked the question, and that Harzan answered that ESP "means everything in time and space is connected." If true, it would mean a top aircraft designer was saying that star travel works through the mind.
